evidence_summary: Official GitHub metadata identifies a public, non-archived repository with default branch main and Apache-2.0 license.
GitHub API and fetched Git ref agree on the current main HEAD and commit timestamp.
GitHub marks v0.0.8 (biomni 0.0.8) as the latest non-draft, non-prerelease release.
v0.0.8 is the newest listed tag; local Git identifies annotated tag object b5d1f34ace96a4114c50b53a902999fc162f4139 peeled to the recorded commit.
The package version constant is 0.0.8.
Static source shows A1 loading environment descriptions, tools, retrieval, know-how, LLM routing, and a LangGraph workflow with code-execution utilities.
Static AST inventory finds 224 unique exposed tool descriptions across 22 modules; implementation files contain 260 top-level functions including helpers.
Static metadata inventory records 76 academic data-lake entries, 41 commercial-mode entries, 113 academic library/tool entries, 111 commercial-mode entries, and the declared dependency surfaces.
Source and official repository documentation expose importing external MCP tools and exposing selected Biomni modules as an MCP server.

Official GitHub Search returned 111 merged PRs with incomplete_results=false; deterministic created-ascending page 1 contained 100 unique PRs from #9 through #244. Title-only change classifications are separately marked as inference in the detailed batch file.

Official GitHub List forks page 1 returned 100 unique public forks and owners; the Link header reported next page 2 and last page 7. Repository metadata reported 690 forks. Default head SHAs and unique-change status were not returned and remain UNKNOWN.

Official GitHub List pull requests returned 38 open PRs on page 1 and zero on page 2. All 38 PR numbers are unique and all base/head identities are full SHAs. Title-only classifications remain inference in the detailed inventory.

Official GitHub Search returned 33 unique closed-unmerged PRs with incomplete_results=false and an empty terminal page. Pull metadata provided 33 full base/head SHA pairs. PR #289 and #290 have identical recorded base and head surfaces, retained as an unresolved duplicate candidate.

Official GitHub Search page 2 returned the remaining 11 unique merged PRs and page 3 returned zero; total_count remained 111 with incomplete_results=false. Together with batch 001, merged PR inventory pagination is exhausted at 111 of 111.

Official commit page 1 and the fetched frozen Git DAG agree on 100 unique newest commits, first and last SHAs, and next page 2/last page 5. The frozen DAG has exactly 487 reachable commits; 42 page-1 records are multi-parent and 29 subjects explicitly map to PRs.

Official List forks page 2 returned 100 unique forks with no overlap against verified page 1. Pagination reported previous 1, next 3, and last 7; all unique-change and fork-owner eligibility states remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.

Official organization endpoints returned 92 public repositories and six publicly visible member usernames, each on an exhausted single page. Metadata-only screening classified 17 HIGH_RELEVANCE, 28 POSSIBLE_RELEVANCE, 32 LOW_RELEVANCE, and 15 IRRELEVANT; those relevance labels are inference.

Official API and fetched Git refs expose 33 public branches on an exhausted page. Parent recomputation matches every recorded head, merge base, and ahead/behind count; 29 branches have ahead=0 and four have nonzero ahead sets requiring lineage analysis.

The exhausted contributors endpoint returned 40 explicit logins (39 User, one Bot) and five anonymous rows whose contribution counts sum to 487. The frozen Git history has 487 reachable commits and 56 exact raw author/committer tuples; raw tuples remain unresolved and are not guessed into GitHub identities.
Phylo announced its company and Biomni Lab product, described the Lab as an Integrated Biology Environment preview with 300+ combined databases/software/tools, and advertised trying it that day.
Phylo published vendor-reported BixBench and preliminary BiomniBench results for the Biomni Lab 2026-02-03 snapshot; this is a report, not independent runtime validation.
Official posts state that Biomni Lab reached GA and added Pro-tier limits/HPC/concurrency. The absolute date is inferred from official activity IDs because the rendered page used relative time.
Phylo described preview/early-access natural-language foundation-model design, training, monitoring, evaluation, and iteration in Biomni Lab.
Phylo announced GeneCards integration for grounded genomic, proteomic, clinical, and functional queries in Biomni Lab.
Phylo described manageMachine creation/deletion/listing of configurable sandboxes and parallel task dispatch with shared storage.
Phylo stated ESMC-6B, ESMFold2, and ESMFold2-Fast were deployed and usable from Biomni Lab chat/HPC.
Phylo documented a user-supplied Boltz API-key connection for structure/affinity prediction, protein/small-molecule design, and screening from Biomni Lab prompts.
Phylo announced Biomni Everywhere and marked Biomni MCP Available now for external-agent access to the IBE at https://mcp.phylo.bio/mcp; Desktop and Mobile were separately coming soon.
Phylo described Biomni x TusoAI as code-free autonomous biology method development and stated access under the Skills tab, with differing enterprise/public rollout terms.
Phylo and Chugai announced deployment of Biomni Lab across single-cell analysis, human genetics, disease biology, and target evaluation using proprietary research data in Chugai's environment.

Official page 2 and the fetched frozen DAG agree on commits 101–200, all unique SHAs and boundaries. The batch contains 29 multi-parent commits and 23 explicit subject-to-PR mappings; page 3 remains pending.

Official List forks page 3 returned 100 unique forks with no overlap against canonical pages 1–2. Pagination reported previous 2, next 4, and last 7; unique-change and fork-owner eligibility remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.

Official List forks page 4 returned 100 unique forks with no overlap against canonical pages 1–3. Pagination reported previous 3, next 5, and last 7; unique-change and fork-owner eligibility remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.
Official page 3 and the fetched frozen DAG agree on commits 201–300, all unique SHAs and boundaries. The batch contains 34 multi-parent commits and 26 explicit PR mappings; page 4 remains pending.

Verified canonical inventories cover all 182 public PRs: 38 open, 111 merged, and 33 closed-unmerged. Parent reduction finds 76 unique author logins, of which 38 already had canonical IDs and 38 required new IDs; no real-name mapping was inferred.

Authenticated official page 4 and the frozen local DAG agree exactly on commits 301–400 and order. All 100 SHAs are unique; the batch has 30 multi-parent surfaces and 19 explicit subject-to-PR mappings. Page 5 remains canonicalization-pending.

Authenticated final page 5 and the frozen local DAG agree exactly on the final 87 commits, positions 401–487 through root commit 54cfd4712e7596cb02aa93c87e22897a2948d5aa. The response has no next link; commit inventory is complete at 487/487. The batch has 20 multi-parent surfaces and 14 explicit subject-to-PR mappings.

Authenticated List forks page 5 returned 100 unique public forks, positions 401–500, with no overlap against canonical pages 1–4. Pagination reported previous 4, next 6, and last 7. Unique-change and owner eligibility remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.

Authenticated List forks page 6 returned 100 unique public forks, positions 501–600, with no overlap against canonical pages 1–5. Pagination reported previous 5 and next/last 7. Unique-change and owner eligibility remain UNKNOWN/NOT_ADDED.

Authenticated terminal List forks page 7 returned 83 unique public forks, positions 601–683, with no overlap against canonical pages 1–6 and no next link. Public fork discovery pagination is exhausted at 683 enumerated entries; unique-change screening remains pending.

In the same authenticated collection window, repository metadata reported forks_count=690 and network_count=690 while exhausted List forks pages enumerated 683 unique public entries. The seven-entry discrepancy is retained as UNKNOWN; no cause or missing public fork identities are inferred.

Parent canonical reduction assigned repo-000093 through repo-000775 to all 683 unique public forks in verified discovery order. No fork owner was added to P and every unique-change status remains UNKNOWN pending branch/commit screening.

Authenticated browser inspection extracted 690 distinct current fork repository links from GitHub Network tree view. Set comparison against 683 REST snapshot identities found 679 common, 11 tree-only, four REST-only, and a 694-identity union. Causes of surface differences remain UNKNOWN.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 268 public branch refs across repo-000093 through repo-000117 with no ref pagination. Sixteen repositories had only upstream-known heads; 23 heads across nine repositories were not in the upstream DAG, of which 15 exactly matched canonical PR heads.

Seven serialized authenticated compare requests resolved the unique non-PR heads in screening batch 001. Three repositories contain substantive unique capability/infrastructure changes (MikeGong1, Irishaze, PayFv); remaining changes are research-only, docs, formatting, or a small non-feature utility. All comparisons share the frozen main merge base.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 135 public branch refs across 11 tree-only and 14 active unscreened forks with no branch pagination. Local upstream/PR SHA resolution left 23 unique non-PR heads for compare.

Serialized compare requests processed 23 unique non-PR heads in screening batch 002: 22 had valid comparisons and m-barthel:vlad had no common ancestor. Results establish Biomni-AD, JHK/kwskws, synthetic-lethality, Bioset, web-UI, benchmark, and diverged-platform change surfaces.
A serialized authenticated GraphQL query verified owner types for all 25 batch-002 repositories: 21 User owners and four Organization owners. Organizations were not assigned person IDs.

Parent commit-set comparison finds a 40-commit common Biomni-AD core and 130-commit union across ten heads; earlier 40/71-commit heads are strict subsets of later Kaimen histories. JHK main/master are both contained in the 25-commit kwskws main union. These are lineage inferences from verified commit sets, not feature decomposition.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 123 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream/PR/screened-head SHA resolution left six new heads for compare and one reused pre-commit head.

Six serialized compare requests resolved new heads in screening batch 003. dabulseco adds an Ollama-first/Streamlit fork; leizhou69 is a diverged model/output/data-lake candidate. Remaining heads are format, config, or PR-lineage surfaces.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query processed the next 25 active fork identities: 24 repositories exposed 89 branch refs with no ref pagination, while historical REST-only Unity-Educational-Formation/Biomni returned NOT_FOUND.

Three serialized compare requests plus exact SHA reuse resolved screening batch 004. Results were one non-feature notebook/CI pair and pre-commit formatting changes; de-grave's only distinct branch is exact open PR #306. No new capability change was retained.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 189 branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream/PR/screened-head resolution left eight new heads for compare.

Eight serialized compare requests resolved screening batch 005. Retained changes are a five-commit RAGAS/ExpeL extension of the JHK lineage, a TCGA converter/data workflow, a Rejuve assistant layer, and a web portal/auth/database deployment. Other heads are PR or formatting surfaces.

Commit-set comparison proves Science-Will-Win contains all 25 commits in the JHK/kwskws lineage and adds five commits for RAGAS, ExpeL graph memory/experiment mode, and answer fixes. The lineage union therefore extends from 25 to 30 commits.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 122 branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local resolution left three new heads for compare and one exact open-PR head.

Three serialized compare requests resolved screening batch 006. All new heads were pre-commit formatting or a generic Python CI workflow; knowledgesystems' only distinct branch exactly matches open PR #292. No new capability change was retained.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 60 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream, PR, and previously screened SHA resolution left five new heads for compare and two exact open-PR heads.

Five serialized compare requests resolved screening batch 007. Retained changes are an API gateway and execution service, provenance instrumentation, LLM usage and single-cell workflow instrumentation, and GH200/aarch64 plus llama.cpp compatibility. One additional head is pre-commit formatting; two exact heads reuse open PR #293 and #299.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 78 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream, PR, screened-head, and canonical-change SHA resolution left 17 new heads for compare, seven exact PR heads, and one previously screened head.

Seventeen serialized base comparisons resolved screening batch 008: 16 succeeded and XxxKrabs:DiscoverOS had no common ancestor. One additional serialized vladsavelyev branch comparison established a 3-ahead/1-behind divergence. Retained surfaces cover amplicon analysis, a derived Bedrock/commercial-mode extension, Benaroya deployment/runtime setup, a MyBiomni AMI/admin/skills platform, and BixBench integration. GitHub returned its 300-file compare cap for the MyBiomni branches, so their visible file lists are incomplete lower bounds.

Exact commit-set membership proves an 85-commit non-linear Amplicon branch union, a 1-to-4-to-7 Benaroya chain, and a 44-to-49-to-54-to-58 MyBiomni chain. Both vladsavelyev new heads contain all 54 commits of change-000006 and add a four-SHA union; their two ChatBedrockConverse commits remain pending patch-id equivalence. These are lineage inferences from verified commit sets, not feature decomposition or canonical-version selection.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 95 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream, PR, screened-head, and canonical-change SHA resolution left 11 new branch refs represented by nine unique SHAs and one exact open-PR head.

Nine serialized compare requests resolved every unique new SHA in screening batch 009. Retained surfaces are alexj-lee provider/security fixes plus a visible-thought prompt change, Lancelot workflow resilience and plaintext chat history, and a diverged Kyle two-stage Skills retrieval architecture. Remaining new heads are documentation or shared pre-commit maintenance; rsflinn maps exactly to open PR #291.

Exact commit-set membership proves the Lancelot 2-to-5-to-8-to-9 commit branch chain; the final merge has the same observable tree diff as its eight-commit parent. Alex and Jiwani expose one exact shared pre-commit head, while Kyle dev and main expose the same 33-ahead/9-behind head. These are lineage inferences from verified commit and diff sets, not runtime validation or canonical-version selection.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 224 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream, PR, screened-head, and canonical-change SHA resolution left 11 new branch refs represented by eight unique SHAs and two exact open-PR heads.

Eight serialized compare requests resolved every unique new SHA in screening batch 010. Retained surfaces are the Scale deployment/multi-model server, a 23abdul Docker/prompt/file-reading refactor, and a highly diverged Ali-Maq Skills+MCP scientific prototype. Remaining heads are shared or stale pre-commit maintenance; MoiraClimentGispert and aevo98765 map exactly to open PR #288 and #286.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL Blob query returned complete, non-binary, non-truncated text for biomni/tool/file_handling.py (25,684 bytes), its tool description (7,884 bytes), and prompt_builder.py (3,260 bytes). The file module defines inspection/listing and readers for text, CSV, Excel, PDF, DOCX, and biological text. It expands arbitrary caller paths without a workspace containment check and contains no write/delete operation.

Exact commit-set membership proves scale-deployment is the six-commit prefix of the ten-commit model-selector-reasoning head and docker_bio is the three-commit prefix of the five-commit biomni_improve head. Two pre-commit SHAs are exact duplicate surfaces across two and three forks respectively. These are lineage inferences from verified commit sets, not runtime validation or canonical-version selection.

One serialized authenticated GraphQL query inventoried all 96 public branch refs across the next 25 active unscreened forks, including owner types, with no ref pagination. Local upstream, PR, screened-head, and canonical-change resolution left ten unique new SHAs and three exact open-PR heads.

Ten serialized comparisons resolved every unique new SHA in screening batch 011. Retained surfaces cover larry virtual-organ tools/environment, llmsc Docker packaging, PheWAS and MyGene database tools, ZN callbacks, and a diverged Amazon Nova provider path. The larry patch hard-codes a plaintext non-provider Anthropic base URL and is security-blocked. Remaining heads are format maintenance or exact open PR #276, #277, and #280.

Exact commit membership proves larry virtual-organ-tool is the three-commit subset of its five-commit main head. The two andrewsu MyGene commits are parallel objects with the same parent, tree SHA 74d8f1eb8fbc86a0cbcfc4cdecaf94209c579369, file blobs, and patches; differing committer timestamps explain the distinct SHAs. These are lineage/deduplication inferences, not runtime validation or canonical-version selection.
